one_line: Promise a number of reasons in the first line, then give each reason its own phone shot of the product.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down static shot: a girl and a baby lying on their stomachs on a cream and taupe mat, a board book and shape-sorter beside them. Voiceover (transcript): "זה לא עוד משטח פעילות רגיל, והנה לכן חמש סיבות". No text.
q1_hook.why: The first line makes a claim and promises five reasons, with the mat and two children in the first frame (H1, H2, H5). The voice starts at 0:00 but no face is shown (H4 partly). Nothing is written, so with sound off the hook is lost (H6, T3 not met).

beats.what: Girl and baby on the mat with a board book; "חמש סיבות" promised by voice
beats.why: Claim plus a counted list to wait for

beats.what: The mat laid flat, folded up, laid flat again; voice says thick, strong, soft
beats.why: Shows the fold early, before the voice names it at 0:17 (transcript)

beats.what: Close-up of the stitched stack edge, then hands open a board book and set a shape-sorter down
beats.why: Neutral colours let the toys stand out, as the voice says

beats.what: A tissue wipes the beige surface, cubes in view
beats.why: The clearest match of picture and voice ("easy to clean")

beats.what: Cubes on the flat mat, then a baby crawling and lying near them
beats.why: A baby using the mat backs the "every stage" claim

beats.what: Girl and baby over the book, then the girl sits with the shape-sorter
beats.why: Independent play shown as the last stage

beats.what: The empty mat in a room corner, cubes first at the far end, then none
beats.why: Ends on the product alone as the voice sums up

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption points to a highlight ("כל ההמלצות שלי מבליס שמורות לכן בהיילייט!"); no question, tag, save or send ask.
q2_flow.why: A promised list of five gives a reason to stay (H5) and a new picture arrives about every 2 s (R3, E2). But the pictures and the voice drift apart (the fold is shown at 0:03, named at 0:17) and no reason is numbered on screen, so the count is hard to follow (R3, R7).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: it ends on the empty mat and a spoken summary. Caption: "כל ההמלצות שלי מבליס שמורות לכן בהיילייט!" (all my Bliss recommendations are saved for you in the highlight).
q3_cta.why: The only ask sits in the caption, so a viewer who watched to the end gets no next step in the voice or on screen (C6). The ask is single and points to something real, a place to find the recommendations (C1, C2).

q4_shown.what: 0:00 two children on the mat. 0:03 to 0:09 the mat flat, then folded up. 0:10 hands open a board book and set a shape-sorter down. 0:15 to 0:19 a tissue wipes the surface. 0:21 to 0:30 children playing. No price or brand.
q4_shown.why: Claims get matching actions, fold, wipe, crawl, so they are shown as well as said (K5, F8). Hands-only shots need no face (S4). The wipe has no spill, so "easy to clean" is not tested, and the voice is the only vouching (S6). Children are on screen, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 15 shots in 34 s, about 2.3 s each, straight cuts, no speed change seen. Mostly static high-angle frames with a few handheld close-ups. Voiceover nearly wall to wall; no on-screen text at all. Ends on the empty mat, no end card.
q5_edit.why: A cut about every 2 s with new angles keeps it moving (E2, R3), and the voice carries the message, but with no captions a muted viewer gets nothing (E4, T1). The last 3 s show the empty mat while the voice sums up, a soft ending (R4).

q6_topic.what: Five reasons the narrator chose a foldable activity mat for her children: soft, neutral, easy to clean, foldable, right for every stage. Serves parents choosing baby floor gear.
q6_topic.why: A checklist of real shopping doubts from a parent who owns the mat: softness, cleaning, storage, style (S6, K6). Practical value with little feeling around it, and no emotional peak (K4, K1 not met).

q7_filmed.what: Mostly static high-angle frames over the mat, top-down for the board book and shape-sorter, handheld close-ups for the folded edge and the wipe. Bright daylight, striped wallpaper, wooden floor. Hands only; the narrator is never seen. A young girl and a baby.
q7_filmed.why: Bright, steady frames with the mat filling the screen show colour and stitching at phone size (F4, F7). Hands from above, at the book and the wipe, give the viewer's own point of view (F5). Original vertical footage with no borders (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: None. No text, subtitle or sticker appears in any frame from 0:00 to 0:33, and no brand name or logo is written on screen.
q8_text.caption: "משטח פעילות שהוא גם פרקטי וגם הכי סטייל בבית". Two short lines, about 17 words, no hashtags, no question; the second line says "כל ההמלצות שלי מבליס שמורות לכן בהיילייט!". No disclosure words.
q8_text.why: With no text at all, the five reasons exist only in the voice, so a muted viewer gets nothing and nothing can be reread (T1, T3, R7). The caption has the keywords ("משטח פעילות") and a style claim but no hashtags (T7), and no partnership words (T8, S7).

weak_points: Not one word on screen; the five reasons are never numbered; the picture drifts from the voice (fold shown before it is named); scripted tone; the CTA sits only in the caption; no disclosure words; children on screen.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one hands-only phone shot per reason (cover, name on a page, page flip, delivery box) in the order spoken, and write each reason on screen with its number.
not_verified: Audio under the voice (cannot hear). Who the narrator is (never on camera). The machine transcript mishears some words (e.g. "עווה", "דוד צדדי"); the five reasons were read from the sense and the pictures. Paid-partnership label: media info says 0; bliss.il is a coauthor. Correction to src/coded: the fold is shown at 0:03 to 0:09, not when the voice names it (0:17), so picture and voice are not matched reason by reason. No text anywhere, confirmed in all six sheets.
